rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a) of the Constitution, Decree No. 611 appoints Stepashin Sergei Vadimovich Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation; signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин', Moscow, Kremlin, 19 May 1999, No. 611.
